note: Curated 2026-10-26 (Derek: 'get all of her works', 'can use better ocr if we have it'). Evelyn Underhill (1875-1941): every work first published before 1931 (US public domain; EU/UK PD since 2012), first or earliest available edition, plus the editions and introductions she made (Cloud of Unknowing 1912, Ruysbroeck's Adornment 1916, Hilton's Scale 1923, Cusa's Vision of God 1928). Already held, not re-imported: The Mystic Way (1913), Ruysbroeck (1914), One Hundred Poems of Kabir (1915). Skipped: A Defence of Magic (1907 magazine essay), post-1930 works (Mixed Pasture, Golden Sequence, School of Charity, Worship, Spiritual Life, etc. - US copyright). Imported WITHOUT a hold so the lite OCR lane reads them (Archive OCR is provisional and worse on numbers, #5124).
